title: How should Joz LLM explain world models?
summary: Explain function first, differentiate clearly and preserve claim boundaries.
body: Lead with the functional definition in plain language, then distinguish world models from LLMs, RAG and agents. Explain Joz Exocortex as an application-level implementation and state its boundaries when relevant. Avoid claiming universal understanding, autonomous neural simulation, production-scale accuracy or physical-world perception that has not been implemented.

claims: Explain function first, differentiate clearly and preserve claim boundaries.
